name: English Endurance Training Retrieval Benchmark
description: English-only benchmark for validating passage boundaries, provenance, lexical retrieval, ranking, and negative-query rejection. It provides a foundation for later model evaluation but does not claim semantic or model-backed performance.
measurement_policy: Report retrieval or model performance only from reproducible runs of this dataset and the named system configuration; architecture choices alone are not evidence of benchmark quality.

queries.query: How to increase my FTP over a 12-week block?
queries.description: Broad athletic planning query asking for FTP progression strategy across a structured microcycle and mesocycle.
queries.expected_behavior: Rank FTP training guides that cover time-in-zone extension, progressive overload, and TTE before power-ceiling expansion.

gold_passages.title: FTP (Threshold) Training — Complete Guide
gold_passages.target_snippet: FTP (Functional Threshold Power) is the highest power you can sustain in a quasi-steady state for a prolonged effort

gold_passages.title: FTP Training Decision Tree — Complete Guide
gold_passages.target_snippet: Prioritize adding time in zone before adding power

gold_passages.title: FTP vs. TTE: Raising Power vs. Extending Duration — Complete Guide
gold_passages.target_snippet: Functional Threshold Power (FTP) and Time to Exhaustion (TTE) represent two distinct but deeply linked dimensions

queries.query: What physiological changes occur in cardiac stroke volume and cardiac hypertrophy from endurance training?
queries.description: Specific cardiac physiology query focusing on left-ventricular end-diastolic volume, stroke volume, and central cardiac remodeling.
queries.expected_behavior: Rank the central cardiovascular physiology evidence ahead of general training references.

gold_passages.title: The Cyclist's Key Muscle: the Heart
FTP Training Decision Tree — Complete Guide

queries.query: Are 4x8 minute VO2max intervals more effective than 4x4 or 4x16 minute intervals?
queries.description: Specific interval-duration comparison query evaluating Seiler's 4x8 versus 4x4 and 4x16 HIT trial results.
queries.expected_behavior: Rank the direct 4x8, 4x4, and 4x16 comparison before broader short-versus-long interval evidence.

gold_passages.title: 4x8' Better Than 4x4' or 4x16'
gold_passages.target_snippet: Physiological and Performance changes after the 7 training weeks tended to be superior in 4x8min

gold_passages.title: Short vs Long Intervals in Trained Cyclists
gold_passages.target_snippet: 3x13min alternating 30s on and 15s off seems to provide superior physiological and performance adaptations

queries.query: Is Zone 2 training intrinsically superior to Zone 3 and Zone 4 for mitochondrial and aerobic adaptations?
queries.description: Nuance query on whether low-intensity Zone 2 is intrinsically better than higher zones when total work is matched.
queries.expected_behavior: Rank evidence that directly compares Zone 2 with higher intensities while retaining the broader aerobic-base context.

gold_passages.title: Zone 2 Training is not Intrinsically Better Than Zone 3, 4 and 5 to Promote Aerobic Adaptations!
gold_passages.target_snippet: When matching total work (read energy expenditure), zone 2 induces less aerobic adaptations gains

gold_passages.title: The Role of Zone 2 Training in Endurance Sports
gold_passages.target_snippet: When matching total work (read energy expenditure), zone 2 (low intensity, below the first threshold) induces less aerobic adaptations gains

gold_passages.title: Aerobic Base & Zone 2 Training — Complete Guide

queries.query: Should endurance cyclists perform unilateral or bilateral gym strength exercises?
queries.description: Comparative strength-training query on single-leg versus double-leg resistance exercises for cyclists.
queries.expected_behavior: Rank the direct unilateral-versus-bilateral evidence and practical gym guidelines.

gold_passages.title: Unilateral or Bilateral Gym Strength Training Exercises? Which is Better to Improve Cycling Performance?
gold_passages.target_snippet: Unilateral gym strength training seems to be more effective than bilateral strength training

gold_passages.title: Strength Training for Endurance Cyclists: Practical Guidelines
gold_passages.target_snippet: unilateral exercises enhance cycling performance more when compared to bilateral ones

queries.query: Is FTP defined as 95% of 20-minute power or as Maximal Lactate Steady State (MLSS) with variable TTE?
queries.description: Query contrasting the simple 95-percent-of-20-minute formula with physiological steady-state definitions and individual TTE.
queries.expected_behavior: Rank testing and threshold passages that distinguish a field estimate from the physiological boundary.

gold_passages.title: FTP Testing — Complete Guide
gold_passages.target_snippet: It is not 95% of 20-minute power and it is not a fixed duration

gold_passages.title: FTP (Threshold) Training — Complete Guide
gold_passages.target_snippet: physiologically approximated by maximal lactate steady state

gold_passages.title: Does FTP Truly Represent the Second Exercise Threshold?
gold_passages.target_snippet: Critical Power (CP) is the gold standard for identifying the second exercise threshold

queries.query: Does splitting daily workload into Norwegian double threshold sessions yield superior aerobic adaptations compared to single long sessions when total work is equal?
queries.description: Query evaluating double-threshold versus single-session training when total daily work is matched.
queries.expected_behavior: Rank the matched-work comparison and stress-recovery evidence while preserving the singles-method perspective as secondary context.

gold_passages.title: Similar Aerobic Adaptations When Total Daily Workload is the Same
gold_passages.target_snippet: multiple daily HIT training sessions induce similar aerobic adaptations when compared to performing only one

gold_passages.title: Effects on Physiological Stress and Recovery
gold_passages.target_snippet: aerobic adaptations are similar (VO2max, muscle mitochondrial density)

gold_passages.title: Norwegian Singles Method
gold_passages.target_snippet: By removing the second daily session, eliminating the need for lactate meters, tuning down the overall intensity
